chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Alī, from ‘Alī ibn Ja‘far, who said:
I heard Abā al-Hasan عليه السلام saying: While the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was seated, an angel entered upon him having twenty-four faces.

So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to him: My beloved Jibrā’īl, I have not seen you in a form like this. The angel said: I am not Jibrā’īl, O Muhammad. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has sent me to marry the light to the light. He said: Who to whom? He said: Fāṭimah to ‘Alī.

He said: So when the angel turned away, there was written between his shoulders: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; ‘Alī is his legatee. Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: Since when has this been written between your shoulders? He said: From before Allah created Adam by twenty-two thousand years.

key_terms.آدَمَ: Adam عليه السلام, whose creation is used as the point before which this inscription already existed.
key_terms.النُّورَ: Light; here referring to the exalted, luminous reality of the holy figures.
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: ‘Alī عليه السلام, to whom Fāṭimah عليها السلام is joined.
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, whom the angel names in the heavenly marriage.
key_terms.مَلَكٌ: An angelic being sent with a divine mission.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the marriage of Fāṭimah عليها السلام and ‘Alī عليه السلام and the pre-eternal status of ‘Alī’s وصاية?
ai.summary: This narration describes an angelic announcement of the marriage of Sayyidah Fāṭimah عليها السلام to Imam ‘Alī عليه السلام, presented as the joining of light with light. It also affirms the pre-temporal inscription of the Messenger’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prophethood and Imam ‘Alī’s عليه السلام wilayah and وصاية before the creation of Adam عليه السلام.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘While Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was seated, an Angel came over who had twenty four faces for him

So he said to Rasool-Allah<sup>saw</sup>: O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sent me to pair up ‘أَنْ أُزَوِّجَ النُّورَ مِنَ النُّورِ’ the Light with the Light. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Who with who?’ He said: (Syeda) ‘Fatima<sup>asws</sup> to Ali<sup>asws</sup>’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So when the Angel turned around, where was (written) between his shoulders: ‘Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> is Rasool<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and Ali<sup>asws</sup> is his<sup>saww</sup> successor<sup>asws</sup>’.

So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Since how many (years) has this been written between your shoulders?’ So he said: ‘From before Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created Adam<sup>as</sup> by twenty two thousand years’.
en.sarwar: 7. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from Salih ibn ‘Aqaba from ‘Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Once the Holy Prophet (s.a) said to Fatima, “Rise and bring that tray.” She went and took out the tray with fresh bread and steaming meat on it. The Holy Prophet (s.a), Ali, Fatima, al-Hassan and al-Husayn (a.s.) continued to have their meals from it for thirteen days. Then ’Umm Ayman saw al-Husayn with certain things with him. She asked, “Where from did you get it?” He replied, “We are having this for our meal for the past thirteen days.” ’Umm Ayman came to Fatima and said, “O Fatima, “If ’Umm Ayman would have anything it is all for Fatima and her sons but if Fatima would have anything then there is nothing in it for ’Umm Ayman. She (Fatima) then took out from the tray food for her and ’Umm Ayman ate but the food from the tray banished. The Holy Prophet (s.a) said, “Had you not fed her (a non-infallible) from it you and your descendants would have had food from it up to the Day of Judgment.”
Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) then said, “The tray is with us and our Al-Qa’im (the one who will rise with Divine Authority) will take it out at his time.”
